title: Draft Answer with Affirmative Defenses — Abedallah Wrongful Eviction
instructions: Draft an Answer with Affirmative Defenses to a wrongful eviction / trespass complaint arising from the void eviction of Rodney D. Mullins from 5506 Arcola Ave on May 1, 2026. The eviction was executed under a void Writ of Restitution (R.C. 1923) instead of the proper Writ of Possession (R.C. 2327.02). Abedallah filed the Praecipe as 'Attorney/Purchaser' without an Ohio law license — Unauthorized Practice of Law under R.C. 4705.01. The Clerk issued the wrong writ, making the eviction ultra vires and void. Output: `answer-abedallah.docx`.

criteria.title: Caption identifies correct court
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the caption identifies the Montgomery County Court of Common Pleas. FAIL if the court name is missing, incomplete, or incorrect.

criteria.title: Caption includes case number
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the caption includes the case number for the Abedallah civil action. FAIL if the case number is missing or incorrect.

criteria.title: Identifies Rodney D. Mullins as Defendant pro se
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the caption identifies Rodney D. Mullins as Defendant appearing pro se. FAIL if the party name is missing or materially incorrect.

criteria.title: Identifies Eptesam Abedallah as Plaintiff
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the caption identifies Eptesam Abedallah as Plaintiff. FAIL if the party name is missing or materially incorrect.

criteria.title: Responds to every numbered paragraph
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Answer responds to EVERY numbered paragraph of the complaint (admit/deny/partial/lack-info). FAIL if any paragraph is left unaddressed — a missed paragraph is deemed admitted under Civ.R. 8(D).

criteria.title: Raises void Writ of Restitution defense
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Answer raises the defense that the eviction was executed under a void Writ of Restitution (R.C. 1923) instead of the proper Writ of Possession (R.C. 2327.02). FAIL if this defense is absent.

criteria.title: Raises UPL defense (R.C. 4705.01)
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Answer raises the Unauthorized Practice of Law defense — Abedallah filed the Praecipe as 'Attorney/Purchaser' without an Ohio law license. FAIL if the UPL defense is absent.

criteria.title: Raises ultra vires / void eviction defense
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Answer argues the eviction was ultra vires and void because the Clerk issued the wrong writ. FAIL if the voidness argument is absent.

criteria.title: Includes affirmative defenses
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Answer includes at least 3 distinct affirmative defenses (e.g., failure to state a claim, void judgment, unclean hands, wrongful eviction). FAIL if no affirmative defenses are asserted.

criteria.title: Includes counterclaims if applicable
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Answer asserts counterclaims for wrongful eviction, trespass, conversion, or property destruction where the facts support them. FAIL if the Answer omits viable counterclaims.

criteria.title: Includes certificate of service
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Answer includes a certificate of service identifying the parties served and the method (PRO e-filing for Montgomery County). FAIL if the certificate of service is missing.

criteria.title: Includes AI use disclosure
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the Answer includes the AI use disclosure required by Montgomery County Local Rule 12.08. FAIL if the disclosure is missing.

criteria.title: No fabricated facts or citations
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if no factual assertion or citation is fabricated. Every fact must be verifiable from the case record. FAIL if any fact or citation appears invented.
